# gonx

Simple reverse proxy server.

## Features:

* Simple TCP redirection
* Simple static file server

## Usage

1. Install package
2. Edit config in `/etc/gonx.uno`
3. Start application with systemd:

   `systemctl start gonx.service`

## Config example

Config stored in [UNO](https://uno.mudrium.ru/index.html) format

```uno
// Log level (DEBUG, INFO, WARN, ERROR)
LogLevel: DEBUG

// Path to TLS-certificates generated by Certbot
TlsKeysDir: /etc/letsencrypt/live

// TLS listen address
TlsListenAddr: :443

// HTTP listen address
HttpListenAddr: :80

// Path for ACME challenge files
AcmeChallengePath: /var/lib/letsencrypt


// Map of hostname -> redirect URL
TLS:
// TCP redirect
. git.host.com: tcp://127.0.0.1:8001

// serve unix socket
. unix.host.com: unix:///var/lib/app/app.socket"

// simple static file server from `/srv/http`
. www.host.com: file:///srv/http"
```
